 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 3 08-09-2025

The instant revision has been preferred against the judgment and order dated 28.06.2025 passed in Cr. Appeal No. 56 of 2019 passed by learned Additional Session Judge-XV, Vaishali at Hajipur as well as against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 24.07.2019 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Vaishali at Hajipur passed in Trial No. 304 of 2019 arising out of Complaint Case No. 304 of 2003.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge-XV, Vaishali at Hajipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner was convicted and sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for three years for offences committed under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and pay a fine of Rs. 10,000/- and in default of payment of fine, he would undergo simple imprisonment of one more month.

The petitioner is further Patna High Court CR. REV. No.824 of 2025(3) dt.08-09-2025 sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment of one year for the offences committed under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and pay a fine of Rs. 5,000/- and in default of payment of fine, he would undergo simple imprisonment of one more month.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has remained in custody for 18  months.

Learned counsel further submits that the judgment and orders of the learned Court below Randhir Singh @ Randhir Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152027675/
1 were mechanical orders and suffers from non-application of judicial mind.

entities.text: Randhir Singh @ Randhir Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The evidence was not considered in its proper perspective and from perusal of evidence, no case under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act is made out.
Learned counsel further submits that the matter needs to be heard.

3. Issue notice to the opposite party no. 2 under ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites must be filed within two weeks, failing which the petition will be dismissed.
4.
Call for the lower court records of Trial No. 304 of 2019 arising out of Complaint Case No. 304 of 2003 to reach this Court within four weeks.
Patna High Court CR. REV. No.824 of 2025(3) dt.08-09-2025 5.

Till disposal of the present criminal revision petition, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Vaishali at Hajipur/concerned court, in connection with Trial No. 304 of 2019 arising out of Complaint Case No. 304 of 2003.
6.

(Arun Kumar Jha, J) Anuradha/-
